Corporate Profile

四環醫藥控股集團有限公司（「四環醫藥」或「本                 Founded in 2001, Sihuan Pharmaceutical Holdings Group Ltd. (“ Sihuan
公司」，連同其附屬公司為「本集團」）成立於二                 Pharmaceutical” or the “Company”, together with its subsidiaries, the “Group”)
零零一年，過往取得了理想發展，現已成為擁                   achieved sound development in the past and has now become a pharmaceutical
有領先研究與開發（「研發」）、營銷和生產能力                 corporation with leading capabilities in research and development (“R&D”),
的醫藥公司。四環醫藥自二零零七年起成為中                   marketing and sales and production. Sihuan Pharmaceutical has been the largest
國 心 腦 血 管（「心 腦 血 管 」）處 方 藥 市 場 最 大 的   cardio-cerebral vascular (“CCV”) drug franchise in China’s prescription drug
製藥公司，其主要藥品歐迪美、源之久、克林                   market since 2007. Its major products such as Oudimei, Yuanzhijiu, Kelinao,
澳、威澳、也多佳、邁諾康等，已廣泛用於治                   Wei’ao, Yeduojia and Mainokang are widely used in the treatment of various
療各種心腦血管疾病。                             CCV diseases.


二零一八年，四環醫藥已邁進第十八年。本集                   Sihuan Pharmaceutical marked its eighteenth year in 2018. The Group
團在中國醫院心腦血管處方藥市場份額穩居首                   continued to be the largest CCV prescription drug manufacturer and is the
位，按醫院採購額計，在中國醫院處方藥市場                   eleventh largest pharmaceutical company in China’s hospital prescription
排名第十一。本集團目前銷售產品及在研發產                   drug market in terms of hospital purchase. The Group’s current products and
品線涵蓋中國五大醫療領域：心腦血管系統、                   R&D pipeline encompass the top five medical therapeutic areas in China: CCV
中樞神經系統、新陳代謝、腫瘤及糖尿病。                    system, central nervous system, metabolism, oncology and diabetes.

革，覆蓋面廣而深，監管與利好同行，創新與                   enhanced scope in terms of industry regulation, development, innovation and
整合並舉。出台政策涵蓋了從藥物研發、上市                   consolidation. Spanning from pharmaceutical R&D, marketing to clinical usage,
到臨床使用等多個方面，目的是為了鼓勵創新                   the new policies are aimed to encourage the development of new drugs, control
藥研發，控制醫療費用及減輕對於醫藥產業的                   of healthcare costs and mitigation of regulatory burden in the pharmaceutical
監管負擔。新政策對於整個醫藥行業的每一個                   industry, brining profound significance to all segments of the industry and
環節，和所有醫藥企業的未來發展，均具有深                   affecting the growth of all pharmaceutical companies.
遠而重大的意義。

環， 董 事 會（「董 事 會 」）在 集 團 風 險 管 治 的 基    risk management. The Board of Directors (“the Board”) has established an
礎架構上，建立了針對 ESG 的管理體系。集團                ESG management system on the basis of the group-wide risk management
亦成立了由董事會成員及各部門主管組成的風                   framework. The Group has set up a Risk Management Committee which is
險管理委員會，委員會除負責統籌和監管集團                   composed of members of the Board and various departmental leaders. The
的風險管理外，也負責確定集團各項 ESG 發展                committee is responsible for coordinating and monitoring our risk management,
策略，並定期召開會議指導及開展旗下公司的                   as well as establishing the ESG development strategies of the Group. The Risk
ESG 相關工作。                              Management Committee also holds regular meetings to guide and initiate ESG-

重要性議題評估                                  Materiality assessment
為加強報告的針對性與回應性，集團依據聯交                     Pursuant to the ESG Reporting Guide of the Stock Exchange and in order to
所《環境、社會及管治報告指引》的要求，委託                    enhance the relevance and responsiveness of the Report, the Group has engaged
第三方諮詢公司進行重要性議題評估，以識別                     a third-party consultancy company to conduct a materiality assessment, in
集團和利益相關方重視的 ESG 議題，確保報告                  which issues that are highly valued by the Group and stakeholders are identified
披露的資訊全面覆蓋集團發展和利益相關方關                     so as to ensure that information disclosed in the Report fully covers the material
注的重點議題。                                  issues pertain to the Group’s development and stakeholders’ concerns.

重要性評估的實施分為三個主要階段：                        The materiality assessment was conducted in three stages:

(i)     基於國家及地方相關標準和政策、行業                (i)     to identify 38 potential ESG issues that may affect the Group’s business
        特點以及本集團自身發展情況，確立了                        or stakeholders with reference to relevant national and local standards and
        38 項可能影響本集團業務或利益相關方                      policies, industrial features and the Group’s own development;
        的 ESG 議題；

(ii)    邀請內部及外部利益相關方（包括員工、               (ii)    to invite internal and external stakeholders (including employees,
        管理層、董事、客戶、供應商和社區）填                       management, directors, customers, suppliers and the community)
        寫線上問卷，以收集意見並識別其對各                        to complete online questionnaires so as to collect and examine their
        議題的關注程度；及                                awareness towards each issue; and

(iii)   分析有效調查問卷後，將該等議題標繪                (iii)   to analyze effective questionnaires and identify material ESG issues by
        於 重 要 性 矩 陣 之 中， 並 歸 納 出 重 要 的           plotting all potential issues in the materiality matrix.
        ESG 議題。

      圾等，由行政部統一收集管理。集團對                     clear regulations for waste sorting in the office area. Recyclable waste

      確規定，廢舊紙箱等可回收廢棄物以及                     stored in separate garbage chambers and are sent to designated locations

商業道德                     BUSINESS ETHICS
在專注業務發展的同時，集團深明合乎商業道     While focusing on business development, the Group understands that operating
德的運作模式對集團的可持續發展尤其重要。     business in an ethical manner is crucial to sustainability. While on the one hand
在不侵犯同業知識產權的前提下，我們堅持竭     avoiding infringement of intellectual property rights of other enterprises in the
力保障集團的重要資源免被侵犯。同時，我們     same industry, we on the other hand strive to protect our important resources
亦重視保護客戶私隱、致力維護實驗動物的權     from being infringed. At the same time, we also attach importance to the
益，並對一切賄賂、勒索、欺詐及洗黑錢等不     protection of customer privacy, strive to safeguard the rights and interests of
法行為抱持「零容忍」的態度。           laboratory animals, and hold a “zero tolerance” attitude towards all illegalities
                         such as bribery, extortion, fraud and money laundering.

保障知識產權                   Protecting intellectual property
為保障知識產權，集團設立了由董事長直接領     In order to protect intellectual property rights, the Group has set up the
導的知識產權部，統一處理知識產權事務和管     intellectual property department, which is responsible for collectively

                                             Management Discussion and Analysis


A. 業務回顧                                A.   BUSINESS REVIEW
      二零一八年，中華人民共和國（「中國」）                   In 2018, new regulations implemented by government bodies such as
      國務院、國家衛計委等部門相繼發佈新                     the State Council of the People’s Republic of China (“PRC” or “China”)
      政策法規，為製藥行業帶來了巨大的影                     and National Health and Family Planning Commission have created
      響和變動。該等新政策法規主要鼓勵創                     tremendous changes and influences on the pharmaceutical industry.
      新及整合。為鼓勵創新，涉及審評審批                     These new regulations mainly encourage innovation and consolidation.
      制度改革、上市許可持有人制度、將創                     Aiming to encourage innovations, the government has unveiled a series
      新藥納入國家醫保藥品目錄等，從創新                     of regulatory reforms involving the Review and Approval System for
      藥 研 發 與 開 發（「研 發 」）、 市 場 准 入 到        Drugs and Medical Devices, the Marketing Authorization Holder
      支付都大力給予鼓勵；二是整合存量，                     (“MAH”) system and inclusion of innovative drugs into the National
      比如一致性評價、「兩票制」、藥佔比控                    Reimbursement Drug Lists. These measures were significant from the
      制、限抗限輔等。                              aspects of the research and development (“R&D”), market access, to
                                            expense payment and settlement of innovative drugs. The government
                                            is also consolidating the industry through requiring bioequivalent tests
                                            for generics, implementing the “two-invoice system”, tightening control
                                            over drug expenditure proportion and monitoring unnecessary use of anti-
                                            infectives and adjuvant drugs.

股息政策                                   DIVIDEND POLICY
根 據 香 港 聯 合 交 易 所 新 增《企 業 管 治 守 則 》要   The Board has approved and adopted a dividend policy on 18 March 2019
求，董事會已於二零一九年三月十八日批准並                   according to the new “Corporate Governance Code“ requirements of the Stock
採納股息政策。                                Exchange of Hong Kong.

1.   本公司可透過股東大會以任何貨幣宣派                 1.    The Company may declare dividends in any currency through the
     股息，惟所宣派的股息不得超過董事會                       shareholders ’ meeting, but the dividends declared shall not exceed
     建議的金額。董事會亦可不時宣派股息                       the amount recommended by the Board. The Board may also declare
     或其他分派。                                  dividends or other distributions from time to time.

2.   本公司宣派任何股息，均應當根據百慕                 2.    Any dividend declared by the Company shall be conducted in accordance
     達公司法、本公司組織章程細則以及其                       with the Bermuda Companies Law, the bye-laws of the Company and

1.    公司及集團資料                               1.   CORPORATE AND GROUP INFORMATION
      四環醫藥控股集團有限公司（「本公司」）                        Sihuan Pharmaceutical Holdings Group Ltd. (the “ Company ” ) is
